sections.heading: Business Description
sections.body: Wholesale trading, storage and handling of TMT bars, MS angles, channels, beams, HR/CR coils and sheets, including loading and unloading by overhead cranes and forklifts within the insured premises.

sections.heading: Scope of Cover
sections.body: The Company will indemnify the Insured against legal liability to third parties for accidental death, bodily injury or disease and accidental loss of or damage to third party property arising out of the insured business at the location of risk during the period of insurance, together with defence costs incurred with the prior written consent of the Company, subject to the limit of indemnity stated in this certificate.

sections.heading: Principal Exclusions
sections.body: Liability under any Workmen's Compensation or Employees' Compensation law; liability arising from use of motor vehicles on public roads; gradual pollution and contamination; products liability after goods have left the premises; contractual liability unless it would have attached in the absence of such contract; fines, penalties and punitive or exemplary damages; war, nuclear and terrorism perils.

sections.heading: Excess
sections.body: Each and every claim for third party property damage is subject to an excess of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) to be borne by the Insured. No excess applies to bodily injury claims.

sections.heading: Important Notice
sections.body: This certificate is issued for information only and is subject to the terms, conditions and exclusions of the Public Liability (Industrial Risks) Policy wording. In the event of any claim, written notice must be given to the issuing office immediately. Stamp duty has been paid by consolidated payment vide order of the Chhattisgarh Stamp Authority. For grievances, contact the Grievance Redressal Officer at the issuing office or the Insurance Ombudsman, Bhopal. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation.
